pois.label: SiC 探测舱(剖切)
pois.detail: 柱头剖开的一面就是整条探测因果链:朝堆侧 HDPE 慢化帽把 MeV 级泄漏中子撞软 → ⁶LiF 转换层(30 µm)把热中子变成带电产物 → 4H-SiC PiN 片 2×2(左列贴 LiF 走热道,右列裸片走快道,硅碳反冲+阈值反应)→ 铜读出板 → 前放。中子进、电脉冲出,没有黑盒。
pois.detail_en: The cut-open head is the whole causal chain: the reactor-facing HDPE cap softens MeV leakage neutrons → a 30 µm ⁶LiF converter turns thermals into charged products → a 2×2 stack of 4H-SiC PiN pads (left column behind LiF = thermal channel, right column bare = fast channel via Si/C recoils and threshold reactions) → copper readout board → preamp. Neutrons in, pulses out, no black box.
pois.sim: LiF 厚度账(design_rounds 账1):透射几何效率峰 4.72% @ 29.9 µm;Σ_th=54.6 cm⁻¹(俘获平均自由程 183 µm),产物射程 α 5.9 / t 33 µm 封顶自吸收;10 µm 只有 3.0%、60 µm 回落 4.0%——定版 30 µm 落峰肩,工艺容差平坦。
pois.sim_en: LiF thickness account (design_rounds #1): transmission-geometry efficiency peaks at 4.72% at 29.9 µm; Σ_th=54.6 cm⁻¹ (183 µm capture mean free path), product ranges α 5.9 / t 33 µm cap the self-absorption; 10 µm gives only 3.0% and 60 µm falls back to 4.0% — the 30 µm design point sits on the flat shoulder, tolerant to process spread.
pois.physics: ⁶Li(n,α)t,Q=4.78 MeV(α 2.05 + t 2.73 MeV),热截面 940 b。效率峰是一场竞争:层厚→俘获多但产物出不来;层薄→产物全出但俘获少。α 在 SiC 里生成 ~26 万 e-h 对(W=7.8 eV),比 MIP 大两个量级——所以这里用 PiN 就够,不需要增益。
pois.physics_en: ⁶Li(n,α)t, Q=4.78 MeV (α 2.05 + t 2.73 MeV), 940 b thermal cross-section. The peak is a competition: thicker converts more but self-absorbs the products; thinner lets products out but converts less. One α makes ~260k e-h pairs in SiC (W=7.8 eV), two orders above a MIP — a plain PiN suffices, no gain needed.

pois.label: 计数屏 · 围界预期账
pois.detail: 小屏有节奏地跳——每 ~5 秒一个脉冲点。这不是装饰:它就是托卡马克屏蔽账在围界的活体读数,跳的是聚变堆泄漏,不是宇宙线。
pois.detail_en: The little screen blips rhythmically — one pulse every ~5 s. Not decoration: it is the tokamak shielding budget read out live at the fence, and what blips is fusion leakage, not cosmic rays.

specs.报警灵敏度: 泄漏 ×10 → 60 s 积分 √N 判 3σ

pois.sim: 围界计数账(design_rounds 账2,锚 tokamak 18 次 Geant4 生产输运):S_n=3.01e20 n/s @14.06 MeV → LiPb 1.0 m + WC-B4C 0.12 m 屏蔽出口快通量 1.9e14 n/m²/s(=REBCO ≥5 年判据线)→ 2 m 硼化混凝土生物屏蔽再压 1e-8 → 58 m 处 1/r² 稀释 → 哨兵位 ~5 n/cm²/s → 0.21 cps。
pois.sim_en: Perimeter counting account (design_rounds #2, anchored to the tokamak's 18 Geant4 production runs): S_n=3.01e20 n/s @14.06 MeV → fast flux exiting the LiPb 1.0 m + WC-B4C 0.12 m shield is 1.9e14 n/m²/s (the REBCO ≥5-year criterion line) → 2 m of borated concrete takes another 1e-8 → 1/r² dilution to 58 m → ~5 n/cm²/s at the sentinel → 0.21 cps.
pois.physics: 整条链只有两种衰减:物质屏蔽的指数律(含氢混凝土快中子 TVL ~0.25 m,2 m = 8 个数量级)和真空的 1/r² 几何律。计数统计服从泊松,√N 就是报警阈值的全部数学。
pois.physics_en: The chain has only two attenuations: exponential material shielding (fast-neutron TVL ~0.25 m in hydrogenous concrete, 2 m = 8 decades) and geometric 1/r². Counts are Poisson; √N is the entire mathematics of the alarm threshold.

pois.label: 4H-SiC PiN · 同源器件
pois.detail: 柱里的探测片与 LGAD 项目(PAN 硅微条改造)同一条外延栈——同样的 50 µm n⁻ 漂移层,只是免掉增益层注入做成 PiN。一次 TCAD 战役,两处收获:PiN 版守围界,LGAD 增益版(d17,M≈5)留给轨道上的 PAN 谱仪升级。宽禁带 3.26 eV 是这里的全部选型理由:室温漏电为零、盲可见光、耐辐照——零冷却、零遮光,火星昼夜温差直接裸跑。
pois.detail_en: The pads share the epitaxial stack of the LGAD project (the PAN silicon-strip conversion) — same 50 µm n⁻ drift layer, minus the gain implant, making a PiN. One TCAD campaign, two deployments: the PiN guards the fence, the gain version (d17, M≈5) is reserved for the orbital PAN upgrade. The 3.26 eV bandgap is the whole selection argument: zero room-temperature leakage, visible-blind, radiation-hard — no cooling, no light-tightening, bare through Martian day-night swings.

specs.n_i: ~8e-9 cm⁻³(比 Si 低 ~18 个数量级)

pois.sim: 漏电流-温度账(design_rounds 账4):SRH 生成电流模型,Si 同几何 300 K 漏 ~nA、350 K 到 µA 级必须制冷;SiC 到 450 K 仍 <1e-20 A。LGAD L2a TCAD 锚点:600 V 反向 IV 全程 1e-31 A/µm——漏电低到击穿都无法从 IV 曲线读出,必须用 McIntyre 电离积分判据。
pois.sim_en: Leakage-vs-temperature account (design_rounds #4): SRH generation model — the same geometry in Si leaks ~nA at 300 K and reaches µA by 350 K, demanding cooling; SiC stays <1e-20 A at 450 K. LGAD L2a TCAD anchor: reverse IV flat at 1e-31 A/µm all the way to 600 V — leakage so low that breakdown cannot even be read off the IV curve, forcing the McIntyre ionization-integral criterion.
pois.physics: 生成电流 ∝ n_i ∝ exp(−Eg/2kT):禁带每宽 1 eV,室温本征载流子少 ~8 个数量级。Si 器件在聚变堆围界要制冷要避光;SiC 把这两项预算直接归零——这就是 14 MeV 中子监测的教科书选型。
pois.physics_en: Generation current ∝ n_i ∝ exp(−Eg/2kT): each extra eV of bandgap buys ~8 decades fewer intrinsic carriers at room temperature. A Si device on a fusion fence needs cooling and light-tightening; SiC zeroes both budgets — the textbook choice for 14 MeV neutron monitoring.

pois.label: 中子哨兵网 · 三层联动
pois.detail: 同款柱子布在三个世界:这里(围界,地表)、地下城玄关(30 m 岩下)、深地实验室(3000 m 岩下)。三块屏并排读,就是每层岩石各自吃掉的数量级:围界每 ~5 s 一跳,玄关每 ~1 分钟偶尔一跳,深地几乎纹丝不动——静默本身就是屏蔽账的活体证明。
pois.detail_en: The same column stands in three worlds: here at the fence (surface), the undercity foyer (under 30 m of rock), and the deep lab (under 3000 m). Read the three screens side by side and you read the decades each rock layer eats: ~5 s blips at the fence, an occasional blip per minute in the foyer, near-total stillness in the deep — the silence itself is the shielding budget, alive.

specs.玄关(30 m 岩): µ 道 ~83 s 一跳(7800 g/cm² = 52 个强子 e 折长度)

specs_en.Foyer (30 m rock): µ channel ~83 s/blip (7800 g/cm² = 52 hadronic e-folds)
specs_en.Deep lab (3000 m): µ ×1e-6, blips on the scale of a month

pois.sim: 三层深度衰减账(design_rounds 账3):地表 GCR 中子 ~0.05 n/cm²/s;30 m 岩把强子分量杀绝(e^-52),剩 radiogenic 中子底 ~1e-5 与 µ 残余 ×0.03;3000 m 处 µ ×1e-6(对表 sci-deeplab-01 竖井卡)、中子只剩裸岩 U/Th (α,n) 底 ~1e-6 n/cm²/s。
pois.sim_en: Depth-attenuation account (design_rounds #3): surface GCR neutrons ~0.05 n/cm²/s; 30 m of rock annihilates the hadronic component (e^-52), leaving a radiogenic neutron floor ~1e-5 and a muon residual ×0.03; at 3000 m the muons are ×1e-6 (cross-checked against the sci-deeplab-01 shaft card) and neutrons drop to the bare-rock U/Th (α,n) floor ~1e-6 n/cm²/s.
pois.physics: 强子在岩石里按 λ≈150 g/cm² 指数消失;µ 靠电离损失慢慢磨,穿透深得多,所以浅地下的'偶尔一跳'几乎全是 µ;深到 3 km 连 µ 都被磨光,只剩岩石自己的放射性在说话。
pois.physics_en: Hadrons vanish exponentially in rock with λ≈150 g/cm²; muons only grind down by ionization and penetrate far deeper, so the shallow-underground 'occasional blip' is almost pure µ; by 3 km even the muons are gone and only the rock's own radioactivity is left talking.
